# agency-research

The **Research** division of [The Agency](https://github.com/msitarzewski/agency-agents): 1 specialist subagents for Claude Code, copied unchanged from upstream.

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add efycacement/claude-kit
/plugin install agency-research@claude-kit
```

Restart the session afterwards. Plugin agents are namespaced: ask for an agent by name ("use the Research Synthesist agent to...") or pick it from `/agents`.

Without the plugin system, copy the files into your Claude Code config:

```bash
cp plugins/agency-research/agents/*.md ~/.claude/agents/
```

## Agents

| Agent | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| 🔍 Research Synthesist | Expert in literature review, source evaluation, and evidence synthesis — turns a scattered pile of sources into a structured, honestly-weighted map of what the evidence actually supports |
